0:
Collecting the scattered Cards... we're
finally down to the last one.
1:
Things got pretty crazy in a lot of ways...
but at least nothing seriously awful
happened, so that's good.
2:
...That said, I can't relax yet, since there's
no telling what'll happen with the last one...
4: Oh, Nymph. What're you doing out here?
5:
What am I doing? You weren't around, so I
came looking for you.
7:
Huh? ...Oh, n-not that I need anything in
particular, but...
8:
M-More importantly, what are YOU doing out
here, Tomoki?
9: Just taking it easy for a bit.
10:
...Around you guys, I can never relax,
wondering when you'll stir up trouble next.
11:
Hey, how rude! Alpha and Delta, maybe, but
I'm not like that, am I?!
14:
...Well, I'm used to it by now, so whatever. I
guess you could even say it's kind of fun
in its own way...
15:
...Really? Tomoki, you have fun when
you're with me?
16:
I only said "you could say," okay? Peace
and quiet is what I like best!
17:
There's still a seventh Card out there. If
you go stirring up extra trouble, I'm not
gonna survive.
18:
...If you mean the seventh one, I found it,
you know?
21:
It really is... wait, hasn't that already
activated?!
22:
Wh-What's gonna happen? Whose wish was it,
and what kind?
24: Huh? Nymph, do you know someth--
28:
............Honestly, it's such a boring, tiny
wish it's ridiculous.
29:
"I wish I could be alone with Tomoki and get
a nice mood going"... something like that.
30:
...But if Tomoki got put to sleep, does that
mean there'd be no nice mood if he were
awake?
31: That kind of bugs me, though...
33:
...Well, whatever. My wish got granted, so I'd
better put it to good use.
36:
...Not that I mind. But just sitting next to
him like this feels like such a waste...
37:
Oh, I know. Since I've got the chance...
maybe I'll practice.
39: If it's okay with you... w-would you be my...
41:
...Wh-why am I stammering? Tomoki's asleep,
so it's not like it's hard to say, right?
46:
...So I just have to say it like that. See? I
can totally do this.
47:
Oh... but maybe that sounded a little too
desperate. Should I go a bit more casual?
48:
"Hey, Tomoki. Be my Master. Come on,
okay?" ...Something like that.
49:
But if it sounds too casual, that's no good
either... It's an important thing, after all.
50:
...Wait, what am I even doing? Wouldn't this
look super embarrassing to anyone
watching?
52:
...... He's sleeping so soundly it's
infuriating...
56:
Even a flick to the forehead and he's still
like this... He really won't wake up no
matter what I do.
59:
...I wonder if he wouldn't wake up even if I
did something like this...
60:
I-It's not like... it's just a little prank, it
doesn't mean anything in particular...
61:
I almost did it once before anyway... So if
it's Tomoki, it's not really a problem if I do,
right...?
66: ...Did I fall asleep at some point? Weird...
67:
Oh yeah, Nymph. You were peering at my
face. What were you doing?
68: Huh?! I-I wasn't doing anything like that!
69:
No, you definitely were... What was it... I
feel like you were saying "It's okay,
right?" or something...
70:
!! I've got it! You were trying to pull some
prank on me while I was asleep, weren't you!
71: I-I wasn't... doing anything like that!
72:
Don't lie! Then why was your face so close
to mine?!
75:
Um... y-yeah! You were sleeping so soundly,
I figured I'd wake you up with a headbutt!
76:
...Now that you mention it, my forehead
does kinda sting a little.
77:
Well, if that's what it was... I'd have liked a
gentler wake-up, but oh well, can't be
helped.
78:
...Oh, right. What happened with that
seventh Card?
79:
It already finished activating. While you
were asleep, Tomoki.
80:
Really? For the last one, that was way too
easy. Kind of a letdown.
81:
Well, it's not like I wanted some weird
trouble to happen, so it's fine.
82:
Okay then, Nymph, shall we head back?
We've gotta tell Ikaros and the others we
got the Card back.
90:
Man, I'm getting hungry. Better hurry home,
or Astraea's gonna throw a fit.
91:
......Seriously, why can't I say something
this simple...?
92:
But... someday, the day will surely come
when I can say it...
